buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of Animal Ear Tags – APLDA, Progeny Testing Project, Chittoor Quantity: 14,700 Ear Tags 1. Description The ear tag shall consist of two parts (Male + Female). The male part shall be a button with a diameter of 27 mm (± 2 mm) and shall have a metal point. The female part shall measure 58 × 69 mm, with a closed h ead. 2. Raw Material The ear tags shall be manufactured from Ether Grade Thermoplastic Polyurethane Elastomer material, resi stant to ultraviolet light and high and low temperatures. The tags shall be tamper-proof and impossible to reopen using a wrench. The manufacturer shall provide documentation from independent and recognised sources demonstrating t he non-reopenability of the tags. A pull test certificate showing a minimum pull force of 25 kgf shall be submitted along with the technical bi d.

3. Weight The weight of the complete ear tag (Male + Female) shall be 7 grams (± 10%). 4. Printing Specifications Printing shall be done by laser as follows: First Line: One-dimensional barcode, Code 128, 10 mm height (± 1 mm). Second Line: Six digits, 10 mm height (± 1 mm). Third Line: Six digits, 18 mm height (± 1 mm). The numbers and barcode shall cover the available area of the female tag, leaving a margin of 2 mm on all sides. The printing shall be sufficiently dark to ensure barcode readability over the years. The manufacturer shall provide documentation demonstrating long-term readability. 5. Identification Numbers The unique animal identification numbers required for printing on the ear tags shall be provided by the Na tional Dairy Development Board (NDDB) through APLDA after successful finalisation of the bid. The successful bidder shall print the identification numbers and corresponding barcodes strictly according to the numbering sequence supplied by NDDB. The quoted price shall include all printing charges. No additional payment shall be made for printing identi fication numbers or barcodes. 6. Colour The colour of the ear tags shall be lemon yellow. 7. Packing The ear tags shall be packed in batches of 100 pieces in good-quality polyethylene bags, indicating the be ginning and ending identification numbers. Five such bags, each containing 100 ear tags, shall be packed in a corrugated box containing 500 ear tags . The remaining quantity, if any, shall be packed separately in a suitable corrugated box. 8. Test Reports The following test reports shall be furnished: a) Ether Grade Test Report for finished ear tags at the time of supply. b) Manufacturer's Test Certificate for raw material along with the technical bid. 9. Quality and Replacement The supplied ear tags shall conform to the prescribed technical specifications. Defective tags, incorrectly printed tags, or tags having duplicate or missing identification numbers shall be replaced by the supplier without additional cost. 10. Delivery and Price The quoted price shall be inclusive of the cost of ear tags, laser printing, applicable taxes, packing, transpo rtation and delivery to the consignee at PTP Chittoor, APLDA. The supplier shall deliver the ear tags in accordance with the delivery schedule specified in the GeM contr act. .
